steps.code:
# Fetch all pages of album library to find an album released in 2021
all_albums = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=login_response['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_albums.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total albums: {len(all_albums)}")
# Print release dates to find 2021 albums
for album in all_albums:
    print(album['album_id'], album['title'], album['release_date'])
